card.summary: The Frederick Douglass Trafficking Victims Prevention and Protection Reauthorization Act of 2025 extends and updates federal programs and grants aimed at combating human trafficking both domestically and internationally through fiscal year 2029. It reauthorizes International Megan's Law, establishes support and education programs for victims, adjusts foreign assistance rules, and modifies country evaluation criteria related to human trafficking.
